Event.Name: Emergency Import Triggered
Event.TriggerLabel: Battery manager triggered emergency grid import
Event.Description: Fires when the battery manager starts a grid charge to hold the overnight power-cut reserve: the battery is below the reserve, or on Agile would be below it by dawn. It does not fire for a charge that buys tomorrow's shortfall or tops up ahead of the Flux peak, for a VPP pre-charge, a Happy Hour, the Flux controller's own overnight charge, or a Force Grid Import.

Event.Name: Grid Export Started
Event.Description: Fires when the battery starts selling to the grid: an overnight export that makes room for tomorrow's solar, or the start of an Axle VPP export.

Event.Name: Grid Export Stopped
Event.Description: Fires when grid export stops and the inverter returns to self-consumption mode.

Event.Name: VPP Event Announced
Event.Description: Fires when a new Axle VPP export event is scheduled (more than 30 minutes away).

Event.Name: VPP Event Started
Event.TriggerLabel: Axle VPP export event is now active
Event.Description: Fires when an Axle VPP export event becomes active. The plugin self-drives the export for the event window (Axle dispatch is ignored).

Event.Name: VPP Event Ended
Event.Description: Fires when an Axle VPP export event ends — the self-driven export stops and self-consumption resumes.

Event.Name: Flood Prevention Pre-Drain Started
Event.Description: Fires when the battery manager begins overnight pre-drain to create headroom for the next day's peak solar absorption (tomorrow's forecast is high enough that a full battery would choke off morning export).

Event.Name: Flood Prevention Pre-Drain Stopped
Event.Description: Fires when overnight pre-drain ends — either the target SOC was reached, dawn broke, the forecast revised down, or export was disabled.

Event.Name: Power Cut Lockout Started
Event.TriggerLabel: 4-hour export lockout active after grid restoration
Event.Description: Fires when the grid is restored after a power cut. Export is suppressed for up to 4 hours while the battery SOC is below the configured floor (default 85%) — export resumes early once the floor is reached.

Event.Name: Power Cut Lockout Cleared
Event.TriggerLabel: Power cut export lockout has expired
Event.Description: Fires when the post-power-cut export lockout ends — the 4-hour window expired or SOC reached the configured floor — and normal export operation resumes.
